messages:
nina_marketing: Quick request for launch blog + one-slide: can runtime produce a compact benchmark comparing float vs q4_1 for redwood/llama-13B@v1.4.0 across three context lengths? Need p50/p90/p95, tokens/sec, and an estimated cost-per-1k tokens. Short deadline: slides locked Tue 9am PT.

eli_runtime: We can do that. Clarify context buckets and whether to include cold-start (model load) numbers or just warmed replicas. Also want to know if function-call traffic should be included.

sam_eng: Suggested buckets: short <=64, medium 256-512, long 1024-1536. Include a small function-call slice (1000 samples) because tokenization changes matter. For warmup: 6 requests per replica; steady window 4k requests.

rowan_product: Please add a tiny appendix CSV with raw pctiles and a short methodology blurb we can paste into the blog. Mark any numbers that come from <200 samples.

eli_runtime: Plan: run paired jobs (float & q4_1), 1.5k samples per bucket, collect p50/90/95, throughput, mem snapshots, and traces for 95th. Retain raw logs for 14 days. I'll prioritize PNGs and the CSV for slides. ETA ~3h.

nina_marketing: 14 days retention OK. Use hosted-normalized cost units; we'll map to dollars later. Thanks — please flag any high variance or OOMs early so we can re-scope slides.

benchbot: Job queued job_id=jb_17677777_a, queued_by=eli_runtime, est=3h, artifacts=png,csv,trace. Link: https://bench.internal/jobs/jb_17677777_a

eli_runtime: Starting now. I'll post the CSV/pngs as soon as steady window finishes.

nina_marketing: Appreciate it! :rocket:
